# Remote Sensing Projects

### LiDAR Forest Structure & Individual Tree Detection

:::: {.lab-card .featured}
<div class="featured-body">
<div class="tag-row">
<span class="tag forest">LiDAR</span>
<span class="tag forest">Individual Tree Detection</span>
<span class="tag forest">Forest Inventory</span>
<span class="tag">R · lidR</span>
<span class="tag">Malcolm Knapp RF</span>
</div>

**Can an algorithm reliably find every tree in a structurally complex BC coniferous forest?**
This project compares two individual tree segmentation approaches —
**Li2012** (3D point-cloud) and **Dalponte2016** (CHM region-growing) — across four forest
plots at Malcolm Knapp Research Forest. 
**Finding:** Choosing the right CHM resolution changed results more than switching between algorithms.

<a class="story-btn" href="labs/lidar-story.html">Read the full story →</a>
</div>
::::

### Land Cover Classification

:::: lab-card
::: tag-row
[Remote Sensing]{.tag} [Image Classification]{.tag} [Landsat]{.tag}
:::
This project applies supervised image classification to Landsat imagery using the Maximum
Likelihood algorithm to map seven land-cover classes including Broadleaf Forest, Coniferous
Forest, Exposed Soil and Rocks, and Water. The workflow includes training and validation
polygons, spectral signature analysis, and accuracy assessment.

[See full lab report (PDF) →](labs/classification.pdf){.project-link}
::::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Spectral Indices and Vegetation Properties

:::: lab-card
::: tag-row
[Spectral Analysis]{.tag} [Vegetation Indices]{.tag} [Remote Sensing]{.tag}
:::
This project analyzes reflectance spectra measured with the ASD FieldSpecPro to compare
live vegetation, dead vegetation, soil, and rock. It computes spectral indices such as
**PRI, SIPI, and ND705**, simulates mixed pixels, and shows how **NDVI** and **NDWI**
respond to increasing live vegetation cover at Landsat spectral resolution.

[See full lab report (PDF) →](labs/spectral.pdf){.project-link}
::::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Wildfire Burn Severity and Vegetation Recovery

:::: lab-card
::: tag-row
[Landsat]{.tag} [Time Series]{.tag} [NDVI / NBR]{.tag}
:::
This project analyzes wildfire burn severity and post-fire vegetation recovery using a
Landsat 8 time series over the Prouton Lakes fire in British Columbia. The workflow includes
cloud masking, NDVI and NBR calculation, yearly compositing, dNBR-based burn severity
classification, and assessment of vegetation recovery from 2018 to 2021.

[See full lab report (PDF) →](labs/wildfire.pdf){.project-link}
